name: @micafox/module-formats
description: Apps that load the built MicaFox SDK as CommonJS, ES modules, tsc output and a bundle

scripts.build: rm -rf ./dist && tsc -b tsconfig.json src/tsc-cjs/tsconfig.json src/bundled/tsconfig.json && echo '{ "type": "commonjs" }' > dist/tsc-cjs/package.json && esbuild src/bundled/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --sourcemap --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/bundled/server.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json src/tsc-cjs/tsconfig.json src/bundled/tsconfig.json && echo '{ "type": "commonjs" }' > dist/tsc-cjs/package.json

author: Artem Horovyi
